about: Department facts the majors' own requirements cannot show, read by outside-major-holdout.ts. 'departments': subjects one Cornell department teaches under; a major whose department subjects include one of them gets them all (department mode). 'majors': per program-id prefix, extra department subjects for a major the app offers (department mode only), or, with notInApp, the own subjects of a major the app does not offer yet (used by every mode, so a student whose plan names that prefix is held to the rule once the major is added). Entries only ever add subjects: a false red, never a false green.

departments.name: Psychology
departments.why: Human Development and Psychology majors are both run by the Department of Psychology (the Human Development BS catalog page names it).

departments.name: Asian Studies
departments.why: The Department of Asian Studies runs the Asian Studies and China and Asia-Pacific Studies majors and teaches the Asian languages.

cornell-eas-bs.why: The Engineering EAS template names its department courses only through elective lists, so no core seat shows the subject.

cornell-isst-bs.why: The ISST core is split between Information Science and Computer Science courses; both subjects are held (strict reading).

cornell-cognitive-science-ba.why: Cognitive Science is a program without a department of its own; its core courses are cross-listed with Psychology, so PSYCH is held too (strict reading).

cornell-health-care-policy-bs.why: Earlier guess at the Health Care Policy prefix, kept so no layer that named it loses it.

cornell-policy-analysis-management-bs.why: Earlier Policy Analysis and Management prefix, kept so no layer that named it loses it.

cornell-systems-engineering-bs.why: Systems Engineering prefix an earlier layer named; kept so it is never released.
